title: Peddi
plot_overview: In a village that goes unrecognized officially, a laborer’s remarkable athletic ability becomes a way to fight for the community’s right to be acknowledged. The story follows his efforts to help his people gain recognition.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy a village-centered story about athletic talent and the fight for recognition; not for you if uneven lip-sync and dialogue delivery issues are distracting.
review_summary: Pros: athletic lead premise; community struggle; clear stakes | Cons: uneven lip-sync; dialogue delivery issues
